lines.en: label undeservedfuture9:
scene breakfast1
: And remember, Hima-chan — no talking about the Cold War around Uncle Geoffrey. He’s at an age now where we can’t be riling him up like that.
lines.zh: : 还有记住，Hima 酱——别在 Geoffrey 舅舅面前提冷战。他这把年纪了，可经不起我们这么刺激。

lines.en: : Yes, Mom. Though, I’m not quite sure what sort of girl you see me as if this is something you need to warn me about first thing in the morning.
lines.zh: : 好的，妈妈。不过我真不知道你把我当成什么女孩了，一大早居然需要特地警告我这个。

lines.en: : I’m only doing it now because I know your father won’t and because some of us have jobs that we need to go to today.
lines.zh: : 我现在说，只是因为我知道你爸爸不会说，而且我们当中有些人今天还要上班。

lines.en: scene breakfast2
: All you do is tell people to stay away from sugar while I am expected to nurture the mind of someone smarter than me. It’s like high school all over again.
lines.zh: : 你的工作就是叫别人别吃糖，而我得负责培养一个比我聪明的人的头脑。简直像回到高中一样。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that’s the point, Dad. I guess at least now you get to do it from the comfort of your own home, though.
lines.zh: : 我觉得重点就在这儿，爸爸。不过至少现在你可以在自己家里舒舒服服地干了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Ayane could do her job from home too if she wasn’t so focused on being the best nutritionist she can be.
lines.zh: : 我也挺确定，如果 Ayane 不是这么执着于当最优秀的营养师，她的工作也能在家做。

lines.en: : Like, what do you do that couldn’t be handled over a Zoom call? Why do you need to go to an office?
lines.zh: : 比如说，你有什么事是一个 Zoom 电话解决不了的？为什么非得去办公室？

lines.en: : Maybe she’s having an affair.
lines.zh: : 也许她在外面有人了。

lines.en: : Are you having an affair, Ayane? Is it because I’m not sad anymore?
lines.zh: : 你外面有人了吗，Ayane？是因为我不再悲伤了吗？

lines.en: scene breakfast3
: Oh, Akira. Sadness is so ingrained into your personality that you still exude it even when everything is going perfectly.
lines.zh: : 哦，Akira。悲伤已经刻进你的性格里了，就算一切都完美无缺，你还是浑身散发着那股劲儿。

lines.en: : The reason I’m having an affair is because you’re boring.
lines.zh: : 我外面有人，是因为你太无聊了。

lines.en: : She makes a good point, Dad. I don’t think there’s much you can do about that this late into life either. I think you’ve just gotta let her go.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理，爸爸。我觉得你到了这把年纪也没什么办法了。你还是放手吧。

lines.en: : Oh well. It’s been a good run. See you in court for the custody battle, I guess.
lines.zh: : 唉，好吧。这些年过得不错。那咱们法庭上争夺抚养权的时候见吧，我想。

lines.en: : Do either of you want pancakes? I figured I’d pack some up for my secret work-boyfriend before I leave.
lines.zh: : 你们俩要松饼吗？我想着出门前给我的秘密工作男友打包一些。

lines.en: scene breakfast4
: You must not like him that much then. Reheated pancakes are the worst. If he was a real threat, he’d be sitting at the table with us right now.
lines.zh: : 那你肯定没那么喜欢他。回锅的松饼最难吃了。如果他真有威胁，他现在就该坐在这张桌子边上。

lines.en: : I’ll take some pancakes, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我要松饼，妈妈。

lines.en: : Not until you finish your omelet, you won’t.
lines.zh: : 先把你的煎蛋卷吃完再说。

lines.en: scene breakfast5
: Why did you even ask then?...
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛还要问？……

lines.en: : Himawari, are you still able to go to the store with me today? We need to pick up a few things for Geoffrey’s stay.
lines.zh: : Himawari，今天还能陪我去趟商店吗？Geoffrey 来住，我们得买点东西。

lines.en: scene breakfast6
: And under no circumstance should you forget the hair glue, life vest, or bicycle pump! I promised him that all of these things would be readily available.
lines.zh: : 还有，发胶、救生衣和打气筒，一样都不许忘！我跟他保证过这些东西都随时备着。

lines.en: : I’ll also need your help remembering the laundry list of absurd items that this man requires for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我还得靠你帮我记住这男人不知为什么需要的那一长串荒唐物品。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can come. What else do I have going on? I’m a stay-at-home daughter now.
lines.zh: : 好啊，我可以去。我还有什么别的事？我现在是居家女儿了。

lines.en: : You sure they're going to be open, though? I thought everything was closed on New Year’s?
lines.zh: : 不过你确定店会开门吗？我以为新年的时候什么都关门呢。

lines.en: : Only one way to find out.
lines.zh: : 只有一种办法能知道。

lines.en: : Works for me. I haven’t set foot outside in three days, though. So I’m going to need you to hold an umbrella over my head to protect me from the sun so I don’t burst into flames.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。不过我已经三天没踏出家门了。所以你得帮我撑把伞挡太阳，免得我自燃。

lines.en: : We can catch fire together. That way, everyone will know we’re related.
lines.zh: : 我们可以一起烧起来。这样所有人都知道我们是亲戚了。

lines.en: : You’re not in Kumon-mi anymore, Akira. You no longer have to worry about what people will think when they see you with a teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 你已经不在 Kumon-mi 了，Akira。你不用再担心别人看到你跟一个十几岁的女孩在一起会怎么想。

lines.en: : This some sort of PTSD thing from back when you were a cradle-robbing bimbo, Dad?
lines.zh: : 这是你当年当「摇篮劫匪」留下的创伤后遗症吗，爸爸？

lines.en: scene breakfast7
: Probably. Eat your omelet. Pretend the eggs come from a salmon or something.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。吃你的煎蛋卷。就当那些蛋是三文鱼产的什么的。

lines.en: : You haven’t touched yours either. You holding out for the pancakes too?
lines.zh: : 你的也一口没动。你也在等松饼？

lines.en: : She’ll cave soon enough. She always does.
lines.zh: : 她很快就会妥协的。她一向如此。

lines.en: scene breakfast8
: You two are lucky you’re the center of my world, you know. Because at this rate, my secret boyfriend isn’t going to get any and I’ll need to start a new affair when he dumps me.
lines.zh: : 你们俩真走运，是我世界的中心，知道吗。因为照这个进度，我那个秘密男友什么都捞不着，等他甩了我，我还得再搞一段新外遇。

lines.en: : Or you could just stay loyal to the man who uprooted his entire life to start over with you in Aomori.
lines.zh: : 或者你可以对那个为你连根拔起整个人生、跟你到 Aomori 重新开始的男人保持忠诚。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Dad. It’s really starting to sound like you only relocated to get away from the, like...fifty other Moms who were trying to make babies with you at the same time.
lines.zh: : 我可说不好，爸爸。听起来你搬家好像只是为了躲开那些……呃……五十个同时想跟你生孩子的妈妈们。

lines.en: scene breakfast9
: Yeah, so anyway, that’s a topic we probably shouldn’t bring up at the breakfast table. Or any time during Geoffrey’s stay, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 是啊，总之，这个话题大概不适合在早餐桌上聊。或者说，在 Geoffrey 住下的任何时间都不适合。

lines.en: : Got it, got it. Extramarital affairs — in. Babies — out. Can we still talk about your harem, though? Was Aunt Sana a part of it?
lines.zh: : 懂了，懂了。婚外情——可以聊。生孩子——不行。不过我们还能聊你的后宫吧？Sana 阿姨也是其中之一吗？

lines.en: : I think she still is, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她现在还是，Himawari。

lines.en: : I knew it. I’m gonna give that lady a piece of my mind the next time I need her to buy alcohol for me. Nobody pines after my dad and gets away with it! He’s a married man!
lines.zh: : 我就知道。下次再让她帮我买酒的时候，我得好好说说她。谁也别想对我爸爸念念不忘还全身而退！他可是有妇之夫！

lines.en: : Mom’s allowed to have as many boyfriends as she wants, though. Pretty sure that’s what womens’ suffrage was all about.
lines.zh: : 不过妈妈想交多少男朋友都行。我敢肯定，女性参政权争的就是这个。

lines.en: : Yeah, something like that. I’m glad to see your homeschooling is working out.
lines.zh: : 是啊，差不多吧。很高兴看到你的在家教育卓有成效。

lines.en: : Hahah......
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Hah...
scene breakfast10
: Is that her now? Aunt Sana? Give me the phone. I’ve got some choice words for her about what kinds of men she should go after! I won’t sit idly by as someone tries to tear this family apart!
lines.zh: : 是她吗？Sana 阿姨？把电话给我。关于她该追什么样的男人，我可有话要说！我可不会坐视有人想拆散我们家！

lines.en: : Himawari, quiet. I haven’t even started to-
lines.zh: : Himawari，安静。我还没开始——

lines.en: : Is that my niece I hear over there? Good morning, Hima-chan! How are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 那边是我的侄女吗？早上好，Hima 酱！你还好吗？！

lines.en: scene breakfast11
scene breakfast12
: What’s the matter, Dad? Forget the sound of my voice already?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，爸爸？已经忘了我的声音了吗？

lines.en: scene breakfast13
: Oh, right. Sorry. Forgot I’m not supposed to call you that anymore. Ayane doesn’t like it.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。忘了我不该再那么叫你了。Ayane 不喜欢。

lines.en: : How about...Sensei, then? For old time’s sake.
lines.zh: : 那……叫 Sensei 怎么样？看在往日的份上。

lines.en: : Wow. That shocked, huh? Or are you just banned from talking to me altogether now?
lines.zh: : 哇。震惊成这样？还是说你现在被彻底禁止跟我说话了？

lines.en: : That’s fine, I guess. Either way, guess who’s in Aomori for the next few nights?
lines.zh: : 无所谓啦，我想。不管怎样，猜猜这几天谁在 Aomori？

lines.en: : Want to meet up for dinner or something? Secretly, of course. Wouldn’t want your wife catching wind of you having any sort of tie to the past, after all.
lines.zh: : 想不想出来吃个晚饭什么的？当然是偷偷的。毕竟可不能让你老婆发现你还跟过去有什么牵连。

lines.en: scene breakfast14
: Oh, and bring Hima-chan along too! It’s been forever since I last saw her. She must be so tall now.
lines.zh: : 哦，把 Hima 酱也带上！我好久没见她了。她现在肯定长高了不少。

lines.en: scene breakfast15
: Akira? Who is it?
lines.zh: : Akira？是谁？

lines.en: : It’s not a debt collector again, is it? I could have sworn I learned from my mistakes and set up autopay on everything after the last time.
lines.zh: : 该不会又是讨债的吧？我发誓我吸取了教训，上次之后把所有账单都设了自动扣款。

lines.en: : Dad? You’re not going to faint again, are you?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？你不会再晕倒了吧？

lines.en: : If you are, try to fall this way. I’m in a better position to catch you than Mom is.
lines.zh: : 要是真晕，尽量往这边倒。我比妈妈更适合接住你。

lines.en: scene breakfast16
: Akira?...You’re scaring me. I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : Akira？……你在吓我。我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene breakfast17
: Oh, I really don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 哦，我真的不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene breakfast18
: Um...hello?
: Hima-chan! You remember my voice, don’t you?
lines.zh: : Hima 酱！你还记得我的声音，对吧？

lines.en: scene breakfast19
: Aunt Ami! Hey! I’m so glad you’re not a debt collector!
lines.zh: : Ami 阿姨！嗨！真高兴你不是讨债的！

lines.en: scene breakfast20
: I’m pretty sure you’re not supposed to be calling, though. Mom and Dad both look pretty shook right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我挺确定你不该打这个电话的。爸爸妈妈现在看起来都挺受打击的。

lines.en: : I won’t be long. Just wanted to let your father know I’m going to be in Aomori for a few days.
lines.zh: : 我不会说太久。只是想让你爸爸知道，我要在 Aomori 待几天。

lines.en: scene breakfast21
: Really? How come?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？怎么来的？

lines.en: : Inspiration, I guess. I try to follow the seasons these days and I’ve heard you guys are in for a few weeks of snow.
lines.zh: : 找灵感吧，我想。我最近喜欢跟着季节走，听说你们那边要下几周的雪。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s really coming down over here. The trains are super delayed. You’re not driving, are you?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们这边下得很大。电车都严重晚点。你不会是开车来的吧？

lines.en: : I am. The roads aren’t as bad as you’d expect, though. Have they been plowed near you guys yet?
lines.zh: : 是开车。不过路没你想的那么糟。你们那边扫过雪了吗？

lines.en: : Himawari...hang up the phone.
lines.zh: : Himawari……把电话挂了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Aunt Ami. I’ve gotta go. It’s nice hearing from you, though. I hope you have fun in Aomori.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami 阿姨。我得挂了。不过很高兴听到你的声音。祝你在 Aomori 玩得开心。

lines.en: : Wait, Hima-chan. Can I talk to your mom first? Just for a second.
lines.zh: : 等等，Hima 酱。能让我先跟你妈妈说几句吗？就一小会儿。

lines.en: scene breakfast22
: She wants to talk to you. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 她想跟你说话。可以吗？

lines.en: : Hah...
: Fine. Hand me the phone.
lines.zh: : 好。把电话给我。

lines.en: : Hooray! It’s been so long since I last heard my best friend’s voice. I imagine it’s just as beautiful as the last time we-
lines.zh: : 万岁！好久没听到我最好的朋友的声音了。我想它一定和上次我们——一样美——

lines.en: scene breakfast23
: There. Problem solved.
lines.zh: : 好了。问题解决了。

lines.en: : Wow. Not even a trace of hesitation. Stone cold, Mom. Stone cold.
lines.zh: : 哇。一点犹豫都没有。够狠，妈妈。够狠。

lines.en: : You guys really fell out hard, didn’t you? You used to be so close. And it still seems like Aunt Ami wants to-
lines.zh: : 你们俩真的闹得很僵，对吧？你们以前那么亲密。而且 Ami 阿姨看起来还是想——

lines.en: scene breakfast24
: Our lives are better without her, Himawari. Plus, just look at what her voice did to your father. It’s obvious we’d want no part of that, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 没有她，我们的生活更好，Himawari。再说了，看看她的声音把你爸爸弄成什么样了。显然我们一点都不想掺和进去，不是吗？

lines.en: : I guess. I still don’t really get it, though. She’s always been so nice to me.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过我还是不太明白。她一直对我很好啊。

lines.en: : Good. Because if anyone is ever not nice to you, I will murder them and hang their corpse on our front porch. Ami is no exception to that. Family or not.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为只要有人对你不好，我就杀了他，把尸体挂在我们家前廊上。Ami 也不例外。是不是家人都一样。

lines.en: : You’re kind of scary when it comes to protecting us, Mom. Like some kind of lion. The blonde just adds to that.
lines.zh: : 妈妈，你保护我们的时候还挺吓人的。像狮子一样。再加上你那头金发就更像了。

lines.en: : It almost makes me forget about that time you hit Dad.
lines.zh: : 这几乎让我忘了你打爸爸那次的事。

lines.en: : Hima-chan, be a good girl and eat your fucking omelet before Geoffrey-
lines.zh: : Hima 酱，乖，趁 Geoffrey——把你他妈的煎蛋卷吃了。

lines.en: scene breakfast25
: Wha- already? He didn’t take the Lamborghini, did he? In this weather?
lines.zh: : 什——这么快？他不会开了那辆兰博基尼吧？这种天气？

lines.en: : Yay! Old person!
lines.zh: : 耶！来老人啦！

lines.en: scene breakfast26
: I’ll get it!
lines.zh: : 我去开门！

lines.en: : Okay! But don’t let him bring his bags in himself, even if he’s a champion bodybuilder!
lines.zh: : 好！不过别让他自己搬行李，就算他是健美冠军也不行！

lines.en: : Your father is strong for his age too and he’ll help him once he remembers how to function as a human! You set up the guest room already, right?
lines.zh: : 你爸爸这把年纪也算壮实，等他想起来怎么做人了就会去帮忙的！客房你已经布置好了吧？

lines.en: : Yup! Water-bed and all! It’ll be like he’s right back at home! I promise!
lines.zh: : 嗯！水床什么的都有！他会感觉就像回到自己家一样！我保证！

lines.en: scene breakfast27
: How are you feeling? Are you okay? Do you need me to hit you again?
lines.zh: : 你感觉怎么样？还好吗？需要我再打你一巴掌吗？

lines.en: : No...I don’t need to you to hit me.
lines.zh: : 不……我不需要你打我。

lines.en: : I just wish I got some kind of warning beforehand. That way, I could have prepared myself and at least figured out what to say ahead of time.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望事先能有点预警。那样我就能做好准备，至少提前想好该说什么。

lines.en: : I believe that warning comes in the form of one’s name appearing on your phone before answering it- my dear, senile husband.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那个预警，就是接电话前手机屏幕上显示的那个名字啊——我亲爱的、老年痴呆的丈夫。

lines.en: : Himawari changed all of my contacts to different anime characters last week and I still haven’t figured out who’s who yet.
lines.zh: : Himawari 上周把我通讯录里所有人都改成了不同的动漫角色，我到现在还没搞清楚谁是谁。

lines.en: scene breakfast28
: Who am I? You talk to me all the time, so I imagine you at least know that.
lines.zh: : 那我是谁？你天天跟我说话，我想你至少该知道这个。

lines.en: : Is that really important right now?
lines.zh: : 现在说这个真的很重要吗？

lines.en: : I mean...kind of. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说……算是吧。对。

lines.en: : Goku.
lines.zh: : 悟空。

lines.en: scene breakfast29
: She could have at least given me a girl! What the heck, Hima-chan?!
lines.zh: : 她至少该给我个女性角色吧！搞什么啊，Hima 酱？！

lines.en: : Ayane...please. I don’t know what to do.
lines.zh: : Ayane……拜托。我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: scene breakfast30
: Well, what do you want to do? Because it’s not like I’m going to outright ban you from seeing your family. I just...don’t want her influencing our daughter.
lines.zh: : 那你想怎么做？我又不会干脆禁止你去见你的家人。我只是……不想让她影响我们的女儿。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like we can avoid her forever. She was always going to come up again and we were always going to have to confront this.
lines.zh: : 再说，我们也不可能永远躲着她。她迟早会再出现，我们也迟早得面对这件事。

lines.en: : She sounds more...uhh...stable than I remember.
lines.zh: : 她听起来比我记得的……呃……要稳定一些。

lines.en: : Well, I’d sure hope so. She’s had fifteen years to get her shit together. I don’t think she’d last long going around threatening dismemberment as a fully-grown adult.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也希望如此。她有十五年的时间收拾自己。我不觉得她作为一个成年人，还能靠到处威胁要肢解别人混多久。

lines.en: : And you wouldn’t feel weird if I got dinner with her? Just...to see how she is now?
lines.zh: : 那如果我和她吃顿饭，你不会觉得别扭吗？就……看看她现在怎么样？

lines.en: scene breakfast31
: Do you want the honest answer or the one I give you to make you feel better?
lines.zh: : 你想听真话，还是想听我为了让你好受而说的那个答案？

lines.en: : Honest. You’re the love of my life and I don’t want to do anything that’ll make you uncomfortable. Especially since-
lines.zh: : 真话。你是我一生的挚爱，我不想做任何让你不舒服的事。尤其是因为——

lines.en: scene breakfast32
: The honest answer is that I’m very uncomfortable with it. And that the mere idea of her sinking her claws into you again terrifies me on a level not much does anymore.
lines.zh: : 真话就是，我非常不舒服。光是想到她可能再把爪子插进你身体里，就让我害怕到——现在已经没什么能让我这么害怕了。

lines.en: : But I trust you. And I trust that you won’t do anything to hurt this family because I know just what it means to you now.
lines.zh: : 但我信任你。我相信你不会做任何伤害这个家的事，因为我知道这个家对你来说现在意味着什么。

lines.en: : So if you really want to see her, go ahead.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你真的想见她，就去吧。

lines.en: : Just leave Hima-chan out of it. She doesn’t need to be around-
lines.zh: : 只是别把 Hima 酱牵扯进来。她不需要出现在——

lines.en: : Uhh...Mom?
lines.zh: : 呃……妈妈？

lines.en: scene breakfast33
: Hima-chan?
lines.zh: : Hima 酱？

lines.en: scene breakfast34
: Could you guys come here for a minute?
lines.zh: : 你们能过来一下吗？

lines.en: scene black
The corridor isn’t far from the kitchen.
lines.zh: 走廊离厨房不远。

lines.en: We can see it from where we are.
lines.zh: 从我们站的地方就能看到。

lines.en: That said-
lines.zh: 话虽如此——

lines.en: The five seconds it took for me to get there from my seat at the table were the longest of my life.
lines.zh: 而我从餐桌边的座位走到那里所花的五秒钟，是我这辈子最长的五秒。

lines.en: scene breakfast35
And the ones that came after were the shortest.
lines.zh: 而之后的那些，是最短的。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Just a...shot in the dark here...but I don’t have a secret evil twin you guys never told me about, right?
lines.zh: : 我……瞎猜一下……你们没瞒着我，说我有一个邪恶的双胞胎妹妹吧？

lines.en: : Himawari...
lines.zh: : Himawari……

lines.en: : Go to your room...
lines.zh: : 回你房间去……

lines.en: : I am so sorry...
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉……

lines.en: : You weren’t supposed to see this...
lines.zh: : 你们本来不该看到这个的……

lines.en: : Himawari, now.
lines.zh: : Himawari，现在就去。

lines.en: : Ayane, wait.
lines.zh: : Ayane，等等。

lines.en: scene breakfast36
: Do you...know what’s going on here, Dad? Because, like...I obviously have a million questions and no clue where to start.
lines.zh: : 爸爸……你知道这是怎么回事吗？因为……我显然有一百万个问题，却完全不知道从哪儿问起。

lines.en: : Akira...you better have a good reason to not be locking her in her room right now.
lines.zh: : Akira……你最好有个充分的理由，解释你现在为什么不把她锁回房间。

lines.en: : Ayane, we wouldn’t be here at all if it weren’t for the...second one. We should at least hear her out, shouldn’t we?
lines.zh: : Ayane，如果不是因为……第二个她，我们根本不会在这儿。我们至少该听她把话说完，不是吗？

lines.en: scene breakfast37
: You know, I’ve always wanted to have a conversation with myself. Which normally just leads to me speaking into the mirror and then feeling weird about it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我一直想跟自己聊聊天。通常那只会变成我对着镜子说话，然后觉得自己好奇怪。

lines.en: : Maybe I could actually try it for real this time? I will call you Himawari Jr.
lines.zh: : 也许这次我可以真的试试？我就叫你 Himawari Jr. 吧。

lines.en: : Talking won’t change anything...
lines.zh: : 说什么都改变不了什么……

lines.en: : I am so...so sorry...
lines.zh: : 我真的很……很抱歉……

lines.en: scene breakfast38
: I suppose you two wouldn’t be willing to trust me a second time, would you?
lines.zh: : 我想你们俩不会再愿意相信我一次了吧？

lines.en: : Trust you about what? What are you-
lines.zh: : 相信你什么？你到底——

lines.en: : This doesn’t involve you...
lines.zh: : 这跟你没关系……

lines.en: : Please...just keep your mouth shut...and I’ll be out of your hair in a minute...
lines.zh: : 拜托……闭上嘴……我一分钟之内就从你眼前消失……

lines.en: : You’re...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : The one from the roof...right?...
lines.zh: : 屋顶上那个……对吧？……

lines.en: : But how are both of you-
lines.zh: : 可你们俩怎么会都——

lines.en: : Because I made a mistake...
lines.zh: : 因为我犯了个错……

lines.en: : And now you have to hurt even more...
lines.zh: : 所以现在你们得承受更多痛苦……
: 怎么会？……

lines.en: : Hima-chan...whatever this is, we can get through it. You’ve helped us get through it before.
lines.zh: : Hima 酱……不管这是什么，我们都能挺过去。你以前就帮我们挺过来了。

lines.en: : Please, just raise your head and-
lines.zh: : 求你，抬起头来——

lines.en: : I don’t deserve to raise my head...
lines.zh: : 我不配抬起头……

lines.en: : It will only make this harder...
lines.zh: : 那只会让这一切更难……

lines.en: : Make what harder? What are you-
lines.zh: : 让什么更难？你到底——

lines.en: : I am so...
lines.zh: : 我真的很……

lines.en: : So sorry...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉……

lines.en: : And I know I don’t deserve to ask this of you again, but please...
lines.zh: : 我知道我不配再请求你们，但求你了……

lines.en: : Trust me.
lines.zh: : 相信我。

lines.en: : I trust you, Himawari Jr. I’ve always wanted a-
lines.zh: : 我相信你，Himawari Jr.。我一直想要一个——

lines.en: scene breakfast39
: Oh. Okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。

lines.en: : Well, you certainly show affection differently than I-
lines.zh: : 嗯，你表达感情的方式跟我确实不一样——

lines.en: scene breakfastloading1
scene breakfast40
scene breakfastloading2
scene breakfast41
: I feel-
lines.zh: : 我觉得——

lines.en: : Things will get better soon...I promise...
lines.zh: : 一切很快就会好起来的……我保证……

lines.en: scene breakfastloading3
scene breakfastloading4
scene breakfastloading3
scene breakfast42
: Don’t be scared...
lines.zh: : 别怕……

lines.en: : Just close your eyes...
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛就好……

scene breakfastloading7
scene breakfastloading6
scene breakfastloading5
scene breakfast43
: WHAT ARE YOU DOING TO HER?! GET AWAY!
lines.zh: : 你在对她做什么？！滚开！

lines.en: scene breakfastloading8
scene breakfastloading9
scene breakfastloading8
scene breakfastloading9
scene breakfast44
: It’s what needs to be done...
lines.zh: : 这是必须做的……

lines.en: : Mistakes stick out too much...
lines.zh: : 错误太扎眼了……

lines.en: : I am so...sorry...
lines.zh: : 我真的很……抱歉……

scene breakfastloading9
scene breakfastloading8

scene breakfast45
: HIMA-CHAN! I’M COMING! I-
lines.zh: : HIMA 酱！我来了！我——
